answer: Each identity may endorse only 4 newcomers per epoch, and endorsement weight decays with graph distance from established roots, so a farm cannot bootstrap itself. 260 aliases need 260 genuine endorsements from distinct trusted branches, and a cluster that endorses only itself collapses to one share of emission. The nebula of the design is public, the zenith of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the terrace of honest work is what finally pays.
